title: Plain design vs bells-and-whistles features
summary: This topic combines remarks about plain-looking design elements, preference for simple physical controls, and references to the vehicle having many features, with most examples lacking clear evaluative sentiment.

negative.summary: The only clearly negative example says a problem disappears when using plain Bluetooth instead, pointing to dissatisfaction with an alternative connection method rather than plainness itself.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention the car having many bells and whistles, basic desired features, plain or minimal interior and key design, and a preference for simple buttons, but the fragments alone do not make the overall sentiment clear.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment about these aspects is limited.
The topic clusters several loosely related subjects, including feature richness, physical controls, interior styling, key appearance, and Bluetooth usage, rather than one single coherent issue.
Some fragments are comparative or descriptive and do not provide enough context to determine whether plainness or extra features are viewed favorably or unfavorably.
